correctness.rationale: Source Lemma4.1 modal matrix [[-f*l²-beta*q²,gamma*q],[beta*q²,-g*l²-gamma*q]] with q=1-1/R0>0 gives characteristic lambda²+A_l lambda+B_l with A_l>0 and B_l=f*g*l^4+(f*gamma*q+g*beta*q²)*l². Therefore B_0=0, eigs at l=0 are 0 and -gamma(R0-1), neutral eigenvector (1,R0-1). Differentiating exact nonlinear constant endemic family E_M=(M/(R0|Omega|),q*M/|Omega|) yields same tangent vector. Nearby E_M with M!=N stay distinct forever and cannot converge to E_N, refuting ambient asymptotic stability. On fixed-mass leaf the neutral direction excluded and for l>0 both A_l,B_l positive (connected domain). Independent exact rational eigenvalue and mass-identity checks confirmed key algebra; no claim of full nonlinear global/orbital stability.
residual_risks: Connected-domain and positive diffusion hypotheses are required to make zero Neumann eigenspace one-dimensional; no nonlinear exponential rate proved.
